back: Cluster: low latency in one AZ (HPC). Spread: each instance on distinct hardware (max 7 per AZ). Partition: isolated groups of racks (Hadoop, Cassandra, Kafka).

es.back: Cluster: baja latencia en una AZ (HPC). Spread: cada instancia en hardware distinto (máx. 7 por AZ). Partition: grupos de racks aislados (Hadoop, Cassandra, Kafka).

back: AWS ARM processors with up to ~40% better price performance for compatible workloads.

es.back: Procesadores ARM de AWS con hasta ~40% mejor precio/rendimiento para cargas compatibles.

back: EC2 (default: instance status) or ELB (application health in the target group). Use ELB to replace instances whose app is down.

es.back: EC2 (por defecto: estado de la instancia) o ELB (estado de la aplicación en el target group). Usa ELB para reemplazar instancias con la app caída.

back: Target tracking (keep a metric), step/simple (alarm-based), scheduled (known peaks), and predictive (ML on patterns).

es.back: Target tracking (mantener métrica), step/simple (por alarmas), scheduled (picos conocidos) y predictive (ML sobre patrones).

back: ALB: HTTP/HTTPS, path/host/header routing, WAF. NLB: TCP/UDP/TLS, millions of req/s, static IP per AZ. GWLB: third-party appliances (GENEVE).

es.back: ALB: HTTP/HTTPS, enrutamiento por ruta/host/headers, WAF. NLB: TCP/UDP/TLS, millones de req/s, IP estática por AZ. GWLB: appliances de terceros (GENEVE).

back: gp3 (general purpose, IOPS independent of size, up to 80,000 IOPS and 2,000 MiB/s), io2 Block Express (up to 256k IOPS), st1 (throughput HDD), sc1 (cold HDD, cheapest).

es.back: gp3 (propósito general, IOPS independientes del tamaño, hasta 80,000 IOPS y 2,000 MiB/s), io2 Block Express (hasta 256k IOPS), st1 (HDD throughput), sc1 (HDD frío, el más barato).

back: Standard/IA/Archive with lifecycle; throughput modes Elastic (recommended), Provisioned, and Bursting. NFS for Linux, multi-AZ.

es.back: Standard/IA/Archive con lifecycle; modos de throughput Elastic (recomendado), Provisioned y Bursting. NFS para Linux, multi-AZ.

front: FSx family: when to use each
back: Windows File Server: SMB/AD. Lustre: HPC with S3 integration. NetApp ONTAP: multiprotocol and NetApp migration. OpenZFS: migrate ZFS.

es.front: Familia FSx: cuándo usar cada uno
es.back: Windows File Server: SMB/AD. Lustre: HPC con integración a S3. NetApp ONTAP: multiprotocolo y migración de NetApp. OpenZFS: migrar ZFS.

back: 3,500 PUT/COPY/POST/DELETE and 5,500 GET/HEAD per second per prefix. Multipart upload (>100 MB, required >5 GB), Transfer Acceleration, byte-range fetches.

es.back: 3,500 PUT/COPY/POST/DELETE y 5,500 GET/HEAD por segundo por prefijo. Multipart upload (>100 MB, obligatorio >5 GB), Transfer Acceleration, byte-range fetches.

back: CRR (cross-Region) and SRR (same Region); requires versioning on source and destination; RTC offers a 15-minute SLA.

es.back: CRR (entre regiones) y SRR (misma región); requiere versionado en origen y destino; RTC ofrece SLA de 15 minutos.

back: Named endpoints with their own policy on a shared bucket; simplify access for many teams or apps.

es.back: Endpoints con nombre y política propia sobre un bucket compartido; simplifican el acceso de muchos equipos o apps.

back: CloudFront Functions: lightweight JS, sub-millisecond, viewer request/response only. Lambda@Edge: more complex logic, network access, origin events too.

es.back: CloudFront Functions: JS ligero, submilisegundo, sólo viewer request/response. Lambda@Edge: lógica más compleja, acceso a red, también eventos de origen.

back: Global Accelerator: 2 static anycast IPs, non-cacheable TCP/UDP, regional failover in seconds. CloudFront: CDN with caching for HTTP(S).

es.back: Global Accelerator: 2 IPs anycast estáticas, TCP/UDP no cacheable, failover regional en segundos. CloudFront: CDN con caché para HTTP(S).

back: Simple, weighted, latency, failover, geolocation, geoproximity (with bias), multivalue answer, and IP-based.

es.back: Simple, weighted, latency, failover, geolocation, geoproximity (con bias), multivalue answer e IP-based.

back: Alias: works at the zone apex and points to AWS resources (ELB, CloudFront, S3) with no query charges. CNAME: not allowed at the apex.

es.back: Alias: funciona en el apex del dominio y apunta a recursos de AWS (ELB, CloudFront, S3) sin costo de consultas. CNAME: no se permite en el apex.

back: HTTP API: cheaper and lower latency for simple proxies. REST API: caching, API keys/usage plans, transformations, WAF, request validation.

es.back: HTTP API: más barata y de menor latencia para proxys simples. REST API: caché, API keys/usage plans, transformaciones, WAF, validación de solicitudes.

front: ECS: task role vs execution role
back: Task role: permissions for the container's application. Task execution role: pull images from ECR, fetch secrets, and send logs.

es.front: ECS: task role vs execution role
es.back: Task role: permisos de la aplicación del contenedor. Task execution role: descargar imágenes de ECR, obtener secretos y enviar logs.

back: Fargate tasks with up to ~70% off for interruption-tolerant workloads (capacity providers).

es.back: Tareas de Fargate con hasta ~70% de descuento para cargas tolerantes a interrupciones (capacity providers).

back: Data Streams: real-time streaming, multiple consumers, ordering per shard, retention and replay. Firehose: managed near-real-time delivery to S3, Redshift, OpenSearch, and more.

es.back: Data Streams: streaming en tiempo real, múltiples consumidores, orden por shard, retención y replay. Firehose: entrega administrada casi en tiempo real a S3, Redshift, OpenSearch, etc.

back: You pay for data scanned: use columnar formats (Parquet/ORC), compression, and partitions.

es.back: Se paga por datos escaneados: usa formatos columnares (Parquet/ORC), compresión y particiones.
